out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The tray dishwasher is expelling lots of water on the floor while in use.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. CFM INFORMED TO HAVE STAFF HOOK UP HOSE WHEN NOT IN USE UNTIL A PERMANENT SOLUTION IS MADE. Maintenance Dept. working on it.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the main 3 compartment sink are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling in the tray dish wash area is peeling as well as areas in the main dishwash area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling in the main dish wash area is in need of cleaning as well as the wall under the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. FAIRFAX COUNTY ADULT DETENTION (Inspection Date: 12/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: deli turkey meat at 47°F in 3 door fridge.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. DISCARDED.
